`CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` is a default, so a subagent's definition or a model Claude passes still takes precedence over it.
also set `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE` to `1`. Requires Claude Code v2.1.257 or later.
use a full model ID such as `claude-opus-5-5` or `claude-sonnet-5`
When the blocked value is a family alias such as `opus`, Claude Code runs the subagent on the newest version of that family the allowlist permits
Custom commands have been merged into skills.
Only you can invoke the skill. Use this for workflows with side effects or that you want to control timing, like `/commit`, `/deploy`, or `/send-slack-message`.
To prevent a subagent from invoking skills entirely, omit `Skill` from the `tools` list or add it to `disallowedTools`.
plugin subagents don't support the `hooks`, `mcpServers`, or `permissionMode` frontmatter fields
Frontmatter effort applies when that skill or subagent is active, overriding the session level but not the environment variable
The available effort levels depend on the model. Models not listed here do not support effort
Aliases point to the recommended version for your provider and update over time
Subagents inherit the configured advisor and apply the same pairing check against their own model.
| `PreToolUse` | Yes | Blocks the tool call |
| `Stop` | Yes | Prevents Claude from stopping, continues the conversation |
| `PostToolUse` | No | Shows stderr to Claude; the tool already ran |
| `SessionStart` | No | Shows stderr to user only |
For command hooks, this JSON arrives via stdin.
Stop hooks receive `stop_hook_active`
Claude Code can read `AGENTS.md` as your project instructions, so a repository already set up for other coding agents works without adding a `CLAUDE.md`, an import, or a setting.
Keep SKILL.md under 500 lines. Move detailed reference material to separate files.
The override applies for the rest of the current turn and isn't saved to settings. The session model resumes when you send your next prompt.
Set environment variables for every session and its subprocesses
When the same key appears in more than one place, Claude Code uses the value from the highest level that sets it.
